editorial:
Imagine two lazy high school dropouts who think they have found an easy way to get rich by robbing the school janitor. Instead of money, they end up leaking dangerous toxic chemicals into the school's water. It sounds like a bad day, but it gets way worse when the swim team drinks the water and turns into green, flesh-eating zombies. You get this wild mix of characters trapped in the building, from horror movie geeks to a metal band and a basketball team that actually cannot play. It feels like a big, messy party where everything goes wrong in the funniest way possible.

You will love the cheesy special effects and the fast energy of the plot. While the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the goofy mood of the film perfectly. It is not a scary movie that will keep you up at night, but it is a blast if you like old-school monster flicks. If you want to see this madness in the best quality, you should grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection or look for it to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a chaotic battle in the gym. The surviving students use their weird hobbies to fight back against the green zombies. After a lot of screaming and running, the main characters manage to trap the monsters and stop the chemical leak. The two dropouts who started the mess finally get what they deserve, and the school is left in ruins. It ends on a light note with the survivors celebrating their victory.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s and 90s B-movies and goofy monsters.
